whitetail_doe_estrus_scent.name: WildHeart Whitetail Doe Estrus Scent
whitetail_doe_estrus_scent.description: Natural aerosol attractant scent that masks hunter odor and lures rutting mature bucks directly downwind.

wildheart_wild_escort.name: WildHeart Wild Escort
wildheart_wild_escort.description: A basic tent for hunting enthusiasts.

lewellings_grande_swift_308.description: Lower-energy cartridge with reduced recoil, suitable for smaller-sized big game.

lewellings_nucleus_break_270.description: Lower-energy cartridge that is suitable for medium-sized big game.

lewellings_nucleus_break_buffed_243.name: Lewellings Nucleus Break Buffed
lewellings_nucleus_break_buffed_243.description: Lower-energy cartridge that is suitable for smaller-sized big game.

primacy_diamond_fixed_blade_short_vanes_.name: Primacy Diamond Fixed Blade Short Vanes
primacy_diamond_fixed_blade_short_vanes_.description: Intended for hunting big game, these arrows fly at a higher speed.

ammo_30_06_springfield_sp.name: .30-06 Springfield Soft Point
ammo_30_06_springfield_sp.description: Heavy hunting load providing controlled expansion and deep penetration for large game like elk, moose, and bear.

ammo_12g_buckshot_00.name: 12 Gauge 00 Buckshot
ammo_12g_buckshot_00.description: Devastating close-range shotshell load optimized for predators, wild boar, and thick brush tracking.

season_pass.description: Complete bundle granting immediate access to all current add-on packs and upcoming reserve expansions.

reserve.name: New Laurentia
reserve.genetic_rule: Species existing across multiple regions maintain completely isolated populations with independent fitness calculations.

mechanic_notes: Feeders provide low impact on animal potential; pollution and invasive plants have a high impact. For instance, white-tailed deer in Lake Sasquatch cannot reach 'Thriving' until Lake Sasquatch pollution is cleared and both feeders are installed.

tasks.name: Clear Invasive Flora: Thunderbird Muskeg (North)
tasks.description: Eradicate invasive plant populations in Thunderbird Muskeg to restore the natural feeding and cover habitat for wetland waterfowl and upland game birds.

tasks.name: Clear Invasive Flora: Thunderbird Muskeg (Central)
tasks.description: Eradicate invasive plant populations in Thunderbird Muskeg to restore the natural feeding and cover habitat for wetland waterfowl and upland game birds.

tasks.name: Clear Invasive Flora: Thunderbird Muskeg (South)
tasks.description: Eradicate invasive plant populations in Thunderbird Muskeg to restore the natural feeding and cover habitat for wetland waterfowl and upland game birds.

tasks.name: Remediate Toxic Runoff: Lake Sasquatch East
tasks.description: Clear chemical pollution and hazardous waste from the eastern shore of Lake Sasquatch to allow deer herds to safely drink and achieve thriving fitness potential.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Slalakum Shore (Ungulates)

tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of Mallards and Eastern wild turkeys in Slalakum Shore.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Slalakum Shore Northwest
tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of Mallards and Eastern wild turkeys in northwestern Slalakum Shore.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Slalakum Shore North
tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of American wolverines and Eastern wild turkeys in northern Slalakum Shore.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Thunderbird Muskeg Northwest
tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of Mallards and Eastern wild turkeys in northwestern Thunderbird Muskeg.

tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of Western moose in northeastern Thunderbird Muskeg.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Thunderbird Muskeg Southeast
tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of Western moose in southeastern Thunderbird Muskeg.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Lake Sasquatch North
tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the fitness potential and population quality of Mallards and White-tailed ptarmigans in northern Lake Sasquatch.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Lake Sasquatch Southwest (Mixed)
tasks.description: Build a habitat enhancement to improve the quality of animal populations in this land. Habitat enhancements improve the fitness potential of Snowshoe hare, Northwestern white-tailed deer, and Dall sheep.

tasks.name: Feed Station: Lake Sasquatch Southwest (Whitetail)

tasks.name: Repair Timber Bridge: Slalakum Shore Southwest
tasks.description: Reconstruct damaged crossing over southwestern waterways in Slalakum Shore to enable vehicle access and rapid foot transit.

tasks.name: Repair Timber Bridge: Slalakum Shore South
tasks.description: Repair collapsed bridge planks along the southern border of Slalakum Shore to reconnect local road paths.

tasks.name: Repair Timber Bridge: Slalakum Shore Southeast
tasks.description: Repair damaged trail bridge on the southeastern border connecting Slalakum Shore into central valley paths.

tasks.name: Repair Heavy Bridge: Thunderbird Muskeg East

tasks.name: Repair Marsh Bridge: Mishipeshu Swamp North
tasks.description: Fix washed-out swamp bridge on northern perimeter to ensure stable ground crossing over high water channels.

tasks.name: Repair Footbridge: Wetiko Foothills South

tasks.description: Repair damaged wooden footbridge leading towards the eastern valleys from Wetiko Foothills.

tasks.name: Repair Footbridge: Kermode Plateau Southeast
tasks.description: Repair elevated stream crossing in southeastern Kermode Plateau.

tasks.name: Repair Canyon Bridge: Jackalope Cordillera West
tasks.description: Restore damaged canyon road bridge on western boundary to open vehicle movement towards Patrick Harper's cabin.

tasks.name: Clear Rockfall: Kermode Plateau Southeast
tasks.description: Clear collapsed rock piles blocking mountain canyon pass in southeastern Kermode Plateau.

tasks.name: Clear Rockfall: Jackalope Cordillera Northwest

tasks.name: Clear Timber Debris: Lake Sasquatch East

engine_rule: 1 in-game year equals exactly 3 in-game days. Animals age by 1 year at the turn of day 3 and despawn of old age if unharvested at max age.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Paddle spread and palm point symmetry peak in late Mature (13-15 yrs). Cull narrow-palmed 1-2 star adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon passing Year 16 (48 in-game days).

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Target 1-star matures around burrows to elevate sett fitness.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Natural mortality occurs after Year 8.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Skull volume reaches maximum potential at Year 17-19.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Very long cycle. Generation replacement requires up to 60 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Solitary predator. Look for uneven skulls or sub-60% genetic markers.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Mature Year 8 marks permanent despawn window.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Fast reproduction cycle; cull uneven coats and low-score adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Natural despawn triggers at the end of Year 6.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Shovel formation and top bez tines expand aggressively between Years 10 and 12.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 36 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Broomed horns occur with age; full curl trophy criteria require Mature status (10+ yrs).
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: High risk of natural death beyond Year 13.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Downward boss curvature peaks late in Mature stage. Harvest sub-75% fitness adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Old age mortality occurs at 45 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Target narrow boss spreads in the adult stage to clear herd genetics.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns at the end of Year 16.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Skull volume reaches maximum potential late in the Mature phase (22-25 yrs).
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Generational recovery takes over 70 in-game days; cull carefully.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Heavy hardened helmet boss forms past Year 14. Cull unjoined boss adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon completion of Year 18.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Hooked horns develop tip spacing gradually; target 1-star matures by Year 11.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 42 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Horn spiral ridges densify during Mature stage. Cull low-ridge adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Natural despawn occurs after 48 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Upper tusks reach trophy curve at Year 10. Cull 1-star adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age at 33 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Full horn curl occurs during mature stage (10-14 yrs). Cull low-mass rams early.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: High risk of natural mortality after Year 14.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Rapid generational cycle; harvest low-weight birds immediately.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns after 12 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Cull sub-50% adult males outside den clusters.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon passing Year 9.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Antler palms develop heavy tine count during mature stage (13-15 yrs).
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age at 48 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Solitary behavior; cull lower weight adults to reset territory quality.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns at the close of Year 8.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Fast turnover; harvest low-weight specimens before natural expiration.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns at the conclusion of Year 4.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Extremely fast generation cycle; cull low-fitness bucks aggressively.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns after 12 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Palmated spatulation peaks at Year 10. Cull spikers and thin palms in adult stage.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Natural death occurs after 33 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Scimitar and twist horn varieties max out length at Years 10-11.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns after Year 12.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Tusk length scales with body mass in Mature stage. Cull asymmetrical boars early.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 30 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Spear horns lengthen steadily; females often hold higher trophy scores than males.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon passing Year 15.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Cull sub-50% fitness jackals during the adult stage to maintain pack quality.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 24 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: High mortality rate; cull pack leaders with sub-60% fitness.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Alpha status shifts at Year 8 death. Despawns permanently after 24 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Third horn curl completes in Mature stage (11-13 yrs). Cull 2-curl adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 42 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Harvest 1-star matures over decoys before seasonal turnaround.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon passing Year 5.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Skull measurements max out late in Mature life stage.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Extremely slow aging cycle. Culling mistakes take over 60 in-game days to recover.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Cull small casque birds in the adult phase.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age at 12 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Heavy mane development and horn circumference peak in Mature stage (11-13 yrs).
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon passing Year 14.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Target lone low-weight adults roaming open savannah zones.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Natural death occurs after 24 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Largest predator skull scores; allow high-fitness boars to reach Year 22+.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Generational reset window takes 75 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Cull light drakes quickly on water resting zones.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns after Year 4.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Dark mane development and skull width peak at Years 11-13.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Pride male resets upon death at Year 14.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Fast generational turnover. Cull low-fitness drakes quickly.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Natural despawn occurs after 12 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: High trophy spurs peak in Mature Year 5. Cull short-bearded toms in Year 3.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 15 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Horns curl tightly backward; harvest 1-2 star rams before Year 12 despawn.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon passing Year 12.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Horn ring count and base thickness optimize around Year 11.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 39 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Both sexes carry antlers; cull weak-framed bulls in adult stages.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns after 36 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Solitary ambush predator; skull measurements max out after Year 10.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Permanent despawn window opens after Year 12.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Cull sub-50% adult males inhabiting low-density taiga pockets.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 36 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Allow 80%+ fitness bucks to reach Mature stage (8-10 yrs) for 5-star trophy rack spread.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Trophy antlers peak in Mature Years 9-10. Must be harvested before Year 11 turnover.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Body weight and plumage density peak in late Mature stages (38-44 yrs). Cull low-fitness adults early.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Extremely long lifecycle. Despawns of old age upon passing Year 45 (135 in-game days).

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Tail feather length peaks at Year 3. Cull short-tailed roosters quickly.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Short life span. Despawns after Year 4.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Antler crowns and mass density crown in Year 11-12. Cull fork-topped adults.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Despawns upon completion of Year 13.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Cull low-weight dogs around burrow paths to clear local bloodlines.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Dies of old age after 21 in-game days.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Pass on spike bulls. Target low-mass mature bulls with uneven main beams.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: Bulls reach maximum 5-star beam spread at Year 13-14. Despawns after Year 15.

species_lifecycles.cull_advisory: Do not harvest in Young stage (1-3 yrs) unless rack is heavily deformed. Harvest 1-2 star Mature before year 12.
species_lifecycles.mortality_warning: 5-Star potential locks in Mature stage. Dies of old age at 36 in-game days.

missions.name: For the Hearth
objectives: Harvest a male Mule deer near your Lodge. Choose to taxidermy it when harvesting.

clusters.cluster_notes: Interacting with any point in this 50-yd river corridor unlocks all linked watering spots.
Creek bend feeding and resting zone cluster.
High alpine scree mineral lick and watering pocket.

hearth_hunt_headquarters.name: Hearth & Hunt Headquarters
hearth_hunt_headquarters.description: A dedicated operations region featuring your expandable master lodge to bring together trophies collected across every reserve, alongside an on-site shooting range and NPC Elijah.

primacy_long_range_choke.name: Primacy Long Range Choke
primacy_long_range_choke.effect: Constricts pellet spread for tighter patterns at extended distances.

elijah.name: Elijah
elijah.description: Guides you through upgrading your master lodge and setting up trophy mounts.

patch_highlights: Improved Duck AI flocking, spooking, and water landing
Rebalanced lethal damage and kinetic energy transfer
Herd group sizing and dynamic dispersion improvements
Over 100 bug fixes and stability improvements
Multiplayer Experimental Branch synchronization and waypoint marker overhaul
genetic_rule: Species existing across multiple regions maintain completely isolated populations with independent fitness calculations.

stewardship_levels.status_desc: Habitat neglected. Heavy inbreeding and poor genetics dominate the herds.
Genetic potential compromised. Aggressive culling of low-tier males required.
Baseline ecosystem health. Feeders and clean water will elevate the herd.
Strong genetics. 3-star and 4-star trophies appearing regularly.
Elite ecosystem. Habitat enhancements active; 5-star trophies spawn consistently.

interventions.culling_quota: Remove at least 2 mature males under 55% fitness per generation to lift regional average.
interventions.pollution_removal: Eliminating toxic runoffs (e.g., Lake Sasquatch) unlocks the genetic ceiling for all surrounding herds.
interventions.feeder_installation: Mineral feeders provide consistent nutrition, shielding young animals from genetic stalls during harsh weather.

tracking_rule: The V-split in cloven hoof prints always points in the direction of animal movement. Follow split prints to intercept active grazing corridors.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: High ridge elevation transitions along sunlit northern slopes.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Sheltered creek beds and pine valley brush to escape deep snow drifts.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Open scrub clearings between 07:00 and 11:00; slow meandering herd pattern.

lifecycles.engine_rule: 1 in-game year equals exactly 3 in-game days. Animals age by 1 year at the turn of day 3 and despawn of old age if unharvested at max age.

species.cull_advisory: Do not harvest in Young stage (1-3 yrs). Harvest 1-2 star Mature before year 12.

interventions.culling_quota: Remove at least 2 mature males under 55% fitness per generation.
interventions.pollution_removal: Eliminating toxic runoffs unlocks the genetic ceiling.
